svg.title: 3D Campus Tour — architecture
svg.desc: 3D Campus Tour: Browser 3D campus explorer · Three.js · Express · MongoDB. Not everyone can visit a campus in person. This tour lets visitors walk through 3D models of campus locations in the browser and open hotspots that explain what they are looking at, with nothing to install.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The public repos show 5 locations as 3D models; no panoramas or React Three Fiber.

svg.text: Hotspots are stored as 3D coordinates in MongoDB rather than

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: baked into the models, so an admin can place, drag and edit

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them in the browser without re-exporting a single model file.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Full 3D models feel more real than flat photos, but each .glb

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: must download before its scene appears and uses GPU

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: memory. The app frees the previous model on every switch:

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: memory stays flat, but going back means reloading it.
